hypotheses.statement: We believe adding a like button to dilemmas will increase engagement, measurable by likes per vote and return rate
hypotheses.rationale: A lightweight like action after voting gives users a way to signal content quality. Tracking like rate per dilemma provides a content quality metric and increases interaction depth per session.

hypotheses.statement: We believe adding a skip button to dilemmas will increase vote completion rate, measurable by vote_cast / pageview ratio
hypotheses.rationale: Users who don't connect with a dilemma currently bounce. A skip button keeps them in the flow and moves them to a dilemma they care about, converting would-be bounces into votes.

designNotes.skipBehavior: One-tap skip, do not resurface the skipped dilemma for that session
designNotes.afterSkip: Show results view (vote percentages, total votes) without highlighting a choice
designNotes.publicVisibility: Do not show skip count publicly — track internally for content quality signals
designNotes.analytics: Track dilemma_skipped event in PostHog with dilemma ID
designNotes.feedsInto: Skip data feeds into weekly-scan and dilemma generation (hyp-manual-004)

hypotheses.statement: We believe a Top 10 most liked dilemmas page will increase return rate, measurable by sessions with >1 pageview
hypotheses.rationale: Once enough likes accumulate, a curated 'best of' page gives returning users a reason to come back beyond the daily question. Requires hyp-manual-001 (likes) to be shipped first.

hypotheses.statement: We believe feeding like/skip signals into dilemma generation will improve content quality over time, measurable by like ratio and vote completion rate trending upward
hypotheses.rationale: Like and skip data creates a feedback loop for content generation. Rather than copying popular topics, Claude should identify underlying themes that resonate (e.g. 'nostalgia-driven choices', 'false dichotomies in everyday habits') and generate dilemmas that tap into those patterns while maintaining topical diversity. Requires hyp-manual-001 and hyp-manual-002 to be shipped first.

experimentVelocity.metric: experiments with status concluded or rolled-back per month
